rationale: Polishes the header editor buttons already present in stable v1.81.0, which hid their labels by a window-width rule (max-width: 720px). The labels now hide by the header's own width (≤ 1024 px, container query) and each button gets its short label as accessible name. Old user-facing surface; include it in the stable user changelog and milestone.

summary.ru: Кнопки редакторов в шапке сворачиваются в иконки, когда шапка не шире 1024 px.
summary.en: Header editor buttons fold to icons when the header is 1024 px wide or narrower.
